description: This file defines a custom exception class AcknowledgementRequestTimeoutException used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents a timeout error when an acknowledgement request does not receive a response within the specified timeout. The class includes multiple constructors, a builder, and methods for creating instances from JSON, all tailored to handle timeout acknowledgment exceptions in Ditto's communication framework.
